- Complete the Finnish translations for auction scanning and privacy settings.
- Track when supported owned auctions are first reported sold by the game.
- Mark queued prices that were also found by the missing-price scan.

- Resume missing-price scans per market and pause recently searched items.
- Share price distributions and seller counts from supported auction scans.

- Add a PQ auction search for items without a recent PandaBase price.

- Add optional local recording of owned auctions and settled sale receipts.

- Share available auction quantities after a completed PQ scan.

- Scan auction pages automatically and show progress on the PQ tab.

- Add a PQ auction tab for sharing prices in batches using the WoW auction house.

- Share completed Auctionator Full Scans that run in summary mode.

- Share completed Auctionator scans through Sync even when quest recording is off.

- Fix /pq price on clients without the global coin formatter.

- Optionally queue Auctionator full-scan prices automatically for Sync.

- Add an optional --share flag to /pq price to send price estimates through Sync.

- Show additional community objective observations on the map and minimap.

- Use the character's quest-log XP when ranking nearby active quests where supported.

- Use recently synced community flight times for known routes.

- Ignore NPCs already seen alive before a nearby kill when measuring respawns.

- Add settings controls for price lookup, quest recommendations, and trace export.

- Look up auction prices by item name or chat link and show the resolved item ID.

- Preview quest items, objects and NPCs beside the map quest details.
- Highlight nearby known quest collection points.
- Add /pq recommend for quest XP and coin, and /pq price for local auction estimates.

- Show recent changelog highlights in the game and list supported games in About & Help.

Ignore the empty community guide placeholder when checking game compatibility.

- Show a world map guide from your ghost to your corpse.

- Keep map pins out of the Leatrix Plus minimap button menu.

- Preview the NPC associated with the selected quest in the world map.
Clearer map markers
- Use native quest objective icons and group nearby spawns.
- Remove gathering frames and overlapping numbers from the maps.

Map and minimap icons
- Use native WoW quest and item icons, with compact gathering borders that retain skill-up colours.

Movement and navigation safety
- Fixed repeated GetSpeed errors when movement speed is a protected client value.
- Restricted speed, facing and mount/flight readings no longer reach navigation calculations.
- ETA uses a safe default when movement data is unavailable.

Documentation update
- Live Forever data and the modern profession recipe reader are described correctly.
- Explained automatic multi-game Sync and the remaining Retail/PTR support limits.
- Added a ready-to-paste CurseForge project summary and description.

PandaQuest changelog. Newest version first, one short line per change.
Data changes read "<kind> <id> - <name> - added|updated|fixed|removed" (kinds: quest, npc, object, item).
Everything else reads "<area> - <what changed>".
Under a data change, indented lines say what changed: "  - coordinates: 3 spawn points added in Badlands".
Older data syncs: see each version's GitHub release notes and https://pd.zroot.it/changelog
